Name: Craftable Mushroom Box - PFM
Author: BlatantDecoy
Description:
Unlock the recipe to craft a Mushroom Box at level 6 foraging.

Can be placed anywhere and takes the usual time with the usual chances to produce rarer mushrooms.

This mod requires [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720]JSON Assets[/url] & [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4970]Producer Framework Mod (PFM)[/url]

Downloads.Description:
Place in StardewValley\Mods folder
Requires SMAPI, JSON Assets & Producer Framework Mod
